name: Storm Sorcery
description: A legacy sorcerer subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Tempestuous Magic
grants.description: Immediately before or after casting a level 1 or higher spell, use a Bonus Action to fly up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

grants.name: Wind Speaker
grants.description: Speak, read, and write Primordial and its Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran dialects.

grants.name: Heart of the Storm
grants.description: Gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. When you begin casting a level 1 or higher spell that deals either type, chosen visible creatures within 10 feet take lightning or thunder damage equal to half your Sorcerer level.

grants.name: Storm Guide
grants.description: As an action, stop rain in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you, ending with a Bonus Action. In windy conditions, use a Bonus Action each round to choose the wind's direction within a 100-foot-radius sphere until the end of your next turn.

grants.name: Storm's Fury
grants.description: When hit by a melee attack, use a Reaction to deal lightning damage equal to your Sorcerer level. The attacker makes a Strength save; on a failure it is pushed up to 20 feet away.

grants.name: Wind Soul
grants.description: Gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage and a 60-foot Fly Speed. As an action, reduce your Fly Speed to 30 feet for 1 hour and grant a 30-foot Fly Speed for 1 hour to 3 + your Charisma modifier creatures within 30 feet. Regain this group flight after a Short or Long Rest.
